facts: Parties: Corrib Capital LLP (Buyer), Marlow Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Pemberton Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 1 May 2026; Closing is scheduled for 29 June 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 1 May 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 24 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 12 September 2026.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
